advice.text: Both axles lock under hard braking: brake pressure too high overall — bring it down to the knee.

advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 33.73; 4/4 launches spun

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 2/3 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Rear-limited corners: rear ARB/springs softer; on throttle (phase 4) accel diff lock -10%.
advice.evidence: 1/3 corners red on the rears (0 on exit)
